privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Detekta, we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our security audit platform.

sections.title: 1. Data Collection
sections.content: We collect information necessary for providing our services:
items: Account Information: Name, email address, and language preferences.
Audit Data: Target URLs, API endpoints, and application files (APK, IPA).
Technical Information: IP addresses (for scan security), browser types, and system logs.

sections.title: 2. Data Usage
sections.content: Your data is used exclusively to:
items: Generate analysis reports via our AI models (Claude AI).
Improve the relevance of our detection algorithms.
Provide technical support and ensure your account's security.

sections.title: 3. AI Processing
sections.content: Detekta uses the Anthropic API (Claude AI) to analyze scan results. Your data is processed ephemerally by the AI and is not used for training third-party models, in accordance with our confidentiality agreements with our providers.

sections.title: 4. Security and Retention
items: AES-256 encryption for data at rest.
Automatic deletion of source files (APK/IPA) after audit completion.
Ability for the user to permanently delete audits and reports at any time.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
sections.content: In accordance with GDPR and data protection laws, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us via our support form.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The use of Detekta implies full and complete acceptance of these Terms of Service (TOS).

sections.title: 1. Service Description
sections.content: Detekta provides automated vulnerability analysis tools for web and mobile applications and APIs. The service includes security scans and AI-generated recommendations.

sections.title: 2. User Responsibility
sections.content: By using Detekta, you warrant that:
items: You have explicit authorization from the owner to audit the submitted target.
You will not use the service for malicious or illegal purposes.
You will not attempt to saturate or compromise Detekta's infrastructure.

sections.title: 3. Warranty Limitations
sections.content: While we use state-of-the-art technologies (OWASP Top 10, Claude AI), Detekta is a security aid tool. We do not guarantee the total absence of vulnerabilities. Detekta cannot be held liable for damages resulting from a cyberattack on a previously audited application.

sections.title: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content on the Detekta platform (software, design, algorithms) is the exclusive property of Detekta. Generated reports belong to the user, subject to compliance with their subscription.

sections.title: 5. Modification of Terms
sections.content: Detekta reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be informed of significant changes via their dashboard.
